test_transform_init: test that Transform initializes all matrices as 4x4 identity matrices
test_transform_set_position: test setting a Transform position to a numpy array and verifying the local transform
test_transform_offset: test applying cumulative offsets to a Transform and verifying the resulting local transform
test_transform_update_transforms: test that updating a parent Transform propagates world transform changes to its children
test_transform_rotate: test setting a Transform rotation via quaternions from Euler angles and verifying the rotation matrix
